notes.title: An error fixed related to save system
notes.notes: We’ve fixed a major bug in the save system. Please note that your old save files might not be compatible anymore. We are really sorry about this.

notes.title: Table Payment & Some Bugs Fixed
notes.notes: [p]We’ve fixed an issue where only one person would pay when multiple people dined at the same table. From now on, everyone will pay their fair share – no more dine and dash![/p][p][/p][p]And some bugs fixed.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for your feedback and support. Keep the reports coming, and we’ll keep improving![/p]
